tags.name: AI suggestions
tags.description: Reply drafts written by the AI from the knowledge base, for agents. The AI never answers a customer by itself: a draft is only sent when an agent approves it.

tags.name: Attachments
tags.description: Images attached to tickets. Files are stored privately and served through short-lived signed URLs.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Session (SPA) and token (mobile) authentication. Send the tenant slug in the X-Tenant header to log in.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: Everyone in the tenant can list categories; only admins manage them.

tags.name: Knowledge base
tags.description: Markdown articles the AI may cite (staff only). Only published, indexed articles are searched; drafts never are.

tags.name: Metrics
tags.description: Dashboard figures for admins, always limited to the current tenant.

tags.name: Push notifications
tags.description: Devices that receive push notifications (mobile app, bearer tokens only).

tags.name: Realtime
tags.description: WebSocket (Pusher protocol, Laravel Reverb) on the API origin under /app. Subscribe to private channels after authorizing them with POST /api/broadcasting/auth.

tags.name: Team
tags.description: Members of the tenant. Staff can list them; only admins create or change them.

tags.name: Ticket messages
tags.description: Conversation on a ticket. Internal notes are only visible to staff.

tags.name: Tickets
tags.description: Customers see and manage only their own tickets; agents and admins see every ticket of the tenant.
